links.outcome: Errors in calculation and unit of measurement in ChatGPT clinical responses
links.effect: Errors in calculation, unit of measurement, and misuse of protocols were identified; some could lead to clinical decisions causing harm.
links.quote: We identified errors in calculation, unit of measurement, and misuse of protocols by ChatGPT.

links.outcome: Existence of citations and references provided by ChatGPT
links.effect: ChatGPT showed citations and references that did not exist in the literature.
links.quote: We also identified citations and references shown by ChatGPT that did not exist in the literature.

links.outcome: Consistency of ChatGPT responses to the same question
links.effect: ChatGPT occasionally provided 2 completely different responses to the same question; response pattern and length differed between users.
links.quote: Occasionally, ChatGPT provided 2 completely different responses to the same question.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, consistency, and citation validity of ChatGPT on clinical drug-therapy and healthcare questions via an expert review panel without testing a specific deployment guardrail or practice.
